comments.author: LeftHandedCat
comments.body_html: This error occured because you have a custom load order that doesn’t include this trader, so it is being loaded AFTER Drakia’s Live Flea Prices mod. make sure if you do have an order.json that this mod is loaded BEFORE Live Flea Prices or it will fail to find my trader because it hasn’t been loaded yet.
